overview: State Representative Christine Barber discussed her campaign for the Second Middlesex State Senate seat, highlighting her record on healthcare access, immigrant rights, and district funding. She detailed her legislative priorities, including school cell phone restrictions and data privacy protections for reproductive care.

items.title: Introduction and State Senate Candidacy
items.summary: State Representative Christine Barber introduced her run for the State Senate district covering Somerville, Medford, Cambridge, and Winchester.

items.title: Legislative Record on Healthcare and Immigration
items.summary: Barber detailed her work passing bills to cap insulin and inhaler co-pays and the Work and Family Mobility Act, which allows undocumented residents to obtain driver's licenses.

items.title: District Results and Community Funding
items.summary: The candidate highlighted her success in securing funding for the Green Line extension, local parks along the Mystic River, and career technical education programs at Medford High School.

items.title: School Cell Phone Ban and Social Media Regulation
items.summary: Barber explained her support for a House-passed bill to implement a bell-to-bell cell phone ban in schools and age verification for social media to address youth mental health.

items.title: Data Privacy and State Protections
items.summary: Barber discussed current efforts to pass a data privacy bill protecting location data for those seeking reproductive or gender-affirming care.

items.title: Campaign Outlook and Upcoming Events
items.summary: The candidate announced a campaign event scheduled for June 2nd at Tamper in Medford Hillside.
